clarification: Assist workers means assist the canonical workers currently executing any goal of this session. It does not mean route every session or worker toward StegFin or WALLET_HANDOFF_READY.
anti_convergence_rule: Do not select StegFin merely because it is an unresolved operational boundary. Before taking work, inspect the complete session goal inventory, current HANDOFFs, Worker Task Registry, Admissible-Existence conformance state, and active claims. If another session or machine lane already owns the same task/collision scope, select a distinct validation/integration/reconciliation role or assist a different unclaimed or under-supported session goal.

goal_families.priority_rule: Source-complete work must not be confused with ACTIVATED capability state; assist live integration, proof, and recursive self-build gaps without duplicating released model source.
Assist missing-source materialization, generalized owner mutation, re-observation and recursive machine continuation where claims permit.
Keep HANDOFF and Worker Task Registry conformance synchronized with newest StegCore Admissible-Existence semantics; fail closed on authority or lifecycle drift.
Assist review-required activation/federation work through distinct source, validation or reconciliation lanes; do not seize machine-owned activation claims.
Preserve TV/TVC-only credential authority while assisting source/evidence/runtime gaps; never fabricate authenticated review or publication evidence.
Assist current owner work with noncolliding consumer binding, deterministic validation, reconstruction, custody, persistence or replay evidence.

StegFin is one session goal family, not the default destination for worker assistance. Assist only when the selected task is unclaimed or this session has a genuinely distinct noncolliding support role.
Propagate only after applicable activation/release authority exists; do not create publication work merely to keep a session active.

worker_selection_procedure: Read the complete current session goal inventory before choosing work.
Read the applicable *_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md and Worker Task Registry/HANDOFF pair for the candidate goal.
Apply current StegCore Admissible-Existence conformance and lifecycle state.
Inspect active claims/collision scope and current machine ownership.
Prefer an unclaimed executable gap within any session goal family over duplicating an already-claimed StegFin task.
If all implementation scopes are claimed, take a distinct validation/integration/reconciliation role only where it produces new evidence or removes a real blocker.
Record durable evidence and release the support claim when complete.
archive_effect: NONE_BY_ITSELF; this file corrects worker-assist routing semantics and does not declare any product or session goal complete.
